note: RSS/Atom feeds across the UK Parliament web estate useful for UPDATE TRACKING (knowing which pages changed without re-crawling the whole sitemap). Probed 2026-06-05 via Node fetch (passes the Cloudflare challenge). Sitemaps give the full URL set; these feeds give the recent deltas.

feeds.covers: All Bills (Bills API) — wrapped by the `bills` facility (`parl bills rss`)

wordpressFeedConventions.note: The Library hosts run WordPress, so the standard WP feed routes are available for finer-grained tracking:

alsoWrapped.library-feeds: api.parliament.uk/library-feeds — aggregator of Commons/Lords Library + POST feeds; wrapped by the `library-feeds` skill.
alsoWrapped.bills: bills-api RSS (all/public/private + per-bill) — wrapped by the `bills` facility.
alsoWrapped.members-news: per-MP blog/news RSS harvested by `parl members news`.
